title: Italian-Style Khichdi Risotto
description: A unique fusion of Italian and Indian flavors, this khichdi risotto is a creative twist on traditional Italian cuisine.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the garam masala and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine and deglaze the skillet, scraping up any browned bits.
Add the rice and khichdi to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the fig jam and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
